member.name: T:JetBrains.ReSharper.Features.Navigation.Features.Goto.AggregatedItemsProviderBase
member.summary: Aggregates several providers in one.
member.remarks:
The resulting items order depents of registration order. Generally, providers with AutoUpgrade flag should come first . i.e. AutoUpgrade happens only when any of providers with unable to found any item.
Fallback providers are asked for items only if all other providers refused to provide items by producing null into
If you combining several AggregatedItemsProviderBase into each other, ensure, that only one provider have LibrariesFlagAutoSwitch set to true. Several providers with AutoSwitch will produce 2^x queries if search failed.
